@@ -51,11 +53,26 @@ function bootstrapScript(image: string): string {

+// oauth2-proxy's ADC-based domain-wide delegation (--google-use-application-default-credentials)
+// builds its Directory API assertion by calling the IAM Credentials signJwt API as the VM's own
+// service account — which requires the SA to hold token creator on itself; no default grants this.
+export const substrateSelfSign = new gcp.serviceaccount.IAMMember("substrate-runner-self-token-creator", {
+  serviceAccountId: substrateRunner.name,
+  role: "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator",

+  location: artifactRepository.location,
+  repository: artifactRepository.name,

input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix portal boot-chain bugs on Container-Optimized OS

Several issues surfaced getting the portal VM to actually boot: Secret
Manager's pretty-printed JSON broke the compact-JSON grep, oauth2-proxy
rejects standard base64 in the cookie secret, a failed secret fetch was
silently swallowed instead of failing the boot, COS has no writable
/root and ships neither docker-compose nor the compose plugin, the VM's
service account lacked both self-signing (needed for ADC-based Google
domain-wide delegation) and Artifact Registry read (needed to pull the
image it just pushed).
EOF
)"
